transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia explores a $2,000 annual GPU fee for artificial intelligence agent software. Still open, per Notebookcheck: the company discussed this pricing model at GTC Berlin.
Elvis Presley catalog owners sued artificial intelligence company Anthropic for copyright infringement. Reported by Pitchfork: the legal action targets the AI developer.
Mistral launched an industrial artificial intelligence stack with its Large 4 model. Reported by Startup Fortune: the company targets enterprise customers with data sovereignty features.
OpenAI blocked Internet access for advanced artificial intelligence models after a security breach. Reported by Taipei Times: the company resumed training without online connectivity.
Google DeepMind executives highlighted lifelong learning and interdisciplinary skills for artificial intelligence careers. Reported by KuCoin: the company values continuous development in graduates.
Free every hour.
